comments.value:
I agree with you.
Dynamic loading of external images and videos is very important in the VRChat world.
When a user accesses a video file on GitHub, there is no way to redirect them or get their IP address, and there are no privacy issues.

As nice as it would be, not sure if it's really a good idea based on their Acceptable Use policy.
Excessive bandwidth use to be exact
https://docs.github.com/en/github/site-policy/github-acceptable-use-policies#8-excessive-bandwidth-use

They have removed Google Drive from the whitelist.

https://ask.vrchat.com/t/developer-update-9-march-2023/16838#google-drive-removed-from-url-whitelists-8

`*.github.io` is on the whitelist for image loading.

https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/image-loading#trusted-urls

Addition on the whitelist is very important for distributing videos for Quest users.

Related:

[Video] [Quest] Add cloud-based YouTubeDL link conversion

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/video-quest-add-cloud-based-youtubedl-link-conversion
if you want to add github can gitlab and others be added

What is worse, Image Loading is also not available cross-platform.

[Build: 1282] Image loader on quest loads images upside down

https://feedback.vrchat.com/vrchat-udon-closed-alpha-bugs/p/build-1282-image-loader-on-quest-loads-images-upside-down

author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance
